english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for replying or speaking in an annoyed, impatient manner.

examples.english: They were late again, so I said crossly, “Could you be on time for once?”
examples.traditional: 佢又遲到，我冇好氣咁話：「你可唔可以準時一次呀？」
